about_pullquote: I fix the jobs everyone else ignores and charge what it's actually worth.
about_para_1: Newcastle Handyman Services was founded over a decade ago on a simple idea: Newcastle residents and small businesses shouldn't have to book five separate traders for five small jobs. We started as a one-person operation and have grown steadily, completing thousands of repairs across the city. From burst pipes at midnight to that squeaky door that's driven you mad for months, we do it all.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we show up on time, charge fairly, and do the job properly. We're not fancy, but we're thorough — and we tidy up after ourselves. Whether it's a landlord property, a young family, or a small shop, we treat every job with the same care and attention.

reviews.text: Called them on a Saturday afternoon with a leaking kitchen tap. Mark arrived within an hour, replaced the cartridge, and sorted a dodgy shelf I'd been worried about for months. Charged me £45 total. Can't recommend highly enough.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Absolute lifesaver. Radiator went off in January and the local plumber wanted £180 just to look at it. These lads fixed it for £65. Honest pricing and quick work. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe under the kitchen sink late on a Friday. rang them as a last resort thinking nobody would come out. They were here in 45 minutes and had it sorted before dinner. Brilliant service, no faffing about.
reviews.author: Michael P.
